action: I check tesbota inventory to see what I'm carrying before choosing a direction.

phases.text: You are standing on a road in wet grass. Fog stands close on every side, and the road runs away from you in two directions. You should probably keep walking.

claims.text: A road runs through wet grass.
Fog stands close around the road on every side, hiding what lies beyond.
The road runs away in two directions.

phases.text: I check tesbota inventory to see what I'm carrying before choosing a direction.
You run through it again: cap, shirt, leggings, boots, bread, cane. For a heartbeat the count comes up seven, one thing too many — and then it's six again, and you can't say what the extra was.

outcomes.text: Everything is as expected: cap, shirt, leggings, boots, cane worn, bread and cane in hand — 1.6 of 5 stone, nothing more, nothing less.
You confirm the count and notice the bread's wrapping has loosened slightly from the walk.
You find a crumb of something unfamiliar caught in the cane's grip-wrap, not bread, not cloth.
The bread is warmer than it should be after this long unwrapped, as though only just out of an oven.
For a moment the tally of what you carry reads one item too many before settling back to what's listed, and you can't say what the extra was.
You find, tucked where the cane meets its wrapping, a second luggage-tag in your own hand, dated for a day that has not happened yet.

chosen.text: For a moment the tally of what you carry reads one item too many before settling back to what's listed, and you can't say what the extra was.

proposal.summary: You pat down your pockets and pack, taking stock of what you're carrying before picking a direction.
